DML.SELECT: SELECT alarm_config_id as "id", alarm_type_id as "alarmTypeId", alarm_level_id as "alarmLevelId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_subtype_id as "elementSubtypeId", element_id as "elementId", element_type_state_id as "elementTypeStateId", mine as "mine", treatment as "treatment", min_time_alarmed as "minTimeAlarmed", threshold_time as "thresholdTime", alias as "alias", description as "description", label_alias as "labelAlias", label_description as "labelDescription", on_create_execute as "onCreateExecute", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.alarm_configs WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.alarm_configs (alarm_config_id, alarm_type_id, alarm_level_id, element_type_id, element_subtype_id, element_id, element_type_state_id, mine, treatment, min_time_alarmed, threshold_time, alias, description, label_alias, label_description, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.alarm_configs'$'alarm_config_id'}, :alarmTypeId, :alarmLevelId, :elementTypeId, :elementSubtypeId, :elementId, :elementTypeStateId, :mine, :treatment, :minTimeAlarmed, :thresholdTime, :alias, :description, :labelAlias, :labelDescription, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.alarm_configs SET alarm_type_id = :alarmTypeId, alarm_level_id = :alarmLevelId, element_type_id = :elementTypeId, element_subtype_id = :elementSubtypeId, element_id = :elementId, element_type_state_id = :elementTypeStateId, mine = :mine, treatment = :treatment, min_time_alarmed = :minTimeAlarmed, threshold_time = :thresholdTime, alias = :alias, description = :description, label_alias = :labelAlias, label_description = :labelDescription, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE alarm_config_id = :id
